summary.tldr: Owners get a rebuilt analytics dashboard with period-aware KPIs and five drill-downs that answer revenue, occupancy, retention, ticket, and team questions without SQL access.
ships: `/analytics` overview page with metric cards + comparison deltas.
Period pill toolbar that opens a calendar directly + preset dropdown.
summary.why: The prior /analytics page was a placeholder; KPI questions required SQL.

topics.title: Period model
topics.summary: Every endpoint accepts the same period contract and computes a matching comparison window for delta chips.
highlights: Shared SQL CTE used by every drill route.
Comparison window matches current window length — 14d compares 14d.

images.alt: Period pill expanded showing preset dropdown and date-range calendar side by side
images.caption: PeriodPill opens the calendar directly; presets live next to it.

screenshots.summary: Six new dashboard surfaces with period-aware KPIs and drill-downs.
highlights: Overview lands on metric cards + breakdown bars + delta chips.
Each drill-down inherits the same toolbar + comparison contract.
Bar lists are click-through to the matching `/reportes/*` slice.

architecture.summary: Six new pages fan out to one analytics API route file backed by sessions + payments queries.
highlights: Pages are Server Components; period CTE shared across all six endpoints.
Toolbar pills round-trip into the URL search params for shareable views.

items: Is the period CTE truly shared, or duplicated across the six endpoints?
Should bar-list click-throughs deep-link to /reportes filters or just the base report?
